_source: Second Harvest Food Bank of Orange County TEFAP partner list (feedoc.org, 10/13/2025), plus independent OC pantries (org sites / 211OC / RCOC directory) and OC Food Bank CSFP senior sites (capoc.org public map). Facts only (name, address, schedule, phone, eligibility). Retrieved 2026-09-18. Verify against each site's sourceUrl before publishing.
_schema_note: Each site has EITHER a weekly 'hours' array (standing weekly hours) OR a monthly nth-weekday schedule described in 'scheduleText' (parsed by prepare-food-data-oc.mjs), OR 'deferred':true for real sites with no fixed/predictable public schedule (rendered as call-ahead vendor cards, no dated activities). Coordinates geocoded from address by prepare-food-data-oc.mjs.
_critical: Eligibility travels with every entry. Senior-only (CSFP/Senior Grocery), appointment-only, registration, and ID/proof-of-residence conditions decide whether someone gets food or gets turned away.
Schedules change with holidays and weather. Surface the phone number and 'call ahead' — be a router to the provider, not the source of truth.
CSFP senior sites distribute monthly on rotating dates; they are deferred as call-ahead cards rather than dated activities to avoid publishing a wrong/expired date.
